title: 8 Limbs of Yoga
tagline: Ashtanga — the complete path of yoga
description: Master the comprehensive eightfold path of yoga, from ethical foundations and physical practice to deep internal states of awareness.

sutra.meaning:
“By the sustained practice of the eight limbs of yoga, the impurities are destroyed and the light of wisdom, discrimination shines forth.”

Yama (moral injunctions), Niyama (observances), Āsana (posture), Prāṇāyāma (regulation of breath), Pratyāhāra (withholding of senses), Dhāraṇā (fixity of attention), Dhyāna (meditation), and Samādhi (absorption of consciousness in the self) are the eight accessories (limbs) of Yoga

sections.gurudevInsight: A seed has the possibility that if it is not watered, then the possibility remains a possibility, it doesn’t manifest. Here patanjali steps in & says yogaangaanushthana - By practicing the limbs of yoga, by observing the limbs of Yoga, through yoga the impurities get eliminated & the viveka, the wisdom shines forth. The husk is gone, the sprout moves though it & comes up. They are (1) Yama (2) Niyama (3) Aasana (4) Pranayama (5) Pratyahara (6) Dhyana (7) Dharana (8) Samadhi. He goes into the details of each & what is the result that you can expect from each one of them. Yoga has 8 limbs, like a chair has got four legs, yoga has 8 limbs, or legs. [PDF p.80]

sections.wisdomFrom: Still others offer as sacrifice the outgoing breath in the incoming breath, while some offer the incoming breath into the outgoing breath. Some arduously practice prāṇāyām and restrain the incoming and outgoing breaths, purely absorbed in the regulation of the life-energy. Yet others curtail their food intake and offer the breath into the life-energy as sacrifice. All these knowers of sacrifice are cleansed of their impurities as a result of such performances.

sections.gurudevInsight: Ya – I see this alps, mountains, water – all this, whatever you see now – these are the proof. Three types of pramana – Pratyaksha – anumana, agama. sutra.meaning: That which transcends the objective external and internal breath regulation is the fourth type of pranayama.

sections.insight: The fourth type of Pranayama goes beyond inhalation,exhalation amd retention. It happens of its own volition wherein a state of pause is experienced in both the breath and the mind. Therefore it is rightly called nirbeej pranayam. This is experienced by sadhak's doing a long session of pranayam for instance during Long kriya.

sections.gurudevInsight: THE 8 LIMBS OF YOGA : Human consciousness is like a seed: - The seed has the possibility of a tree, of the leaves, of the branches, of the roots, of the flowers, of the fruits, of multiplication. A seeds needs a proper ground, proper conditions, sunlight, water, proper soil for it to sprout & blossoms, isn’t it? Same is the case with the human consciousness, human mind. Either the seed can be dormant for years together, keeping its possibility within itself or start blossoming, start sprouting; the spouting of the seed of human consciousness is viveka, Discrimination, wisdom. Freedom comes with viveka or discrimination. [PDF p.80]
